items.quote: Den Betrag erbitten wir innerhalb von 30 Tagen nach Rechnungsdatum auf unser Konto;
items.computation: Start: Rechnungsdatum = 19.11.2026 (date of invoice, the triggering event). Under §187 Abs.1 BGB the day of the event is not counted, so the 30-day period begins 20.11.2026. Counting 30 days forward (§188 Abs.1 BGB), day 30 falls on 19.12.2026 (Nov 19→30 = 11 days, Dec 1→19 = 19 days, total 30). 19.12.2026 is a Saturday. Since this is a payment deadline, §193 BGB moves the end of the period to the next working day if it falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday. 20.12.2026 is a Sunday, so the next working day is Monday 21.12.2026, which is not a public holiday in NW. Final due date: 21.12.2026.
